DOJ Asks Court to Uphold Trump's Ban on CNN, MS Now, Politico

The U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) has asked a court to uphold a ban previously imposed by the Trump White House on CNN, MS Now, and Politico. The DOJ is defending the ban, seeking its reinstatement.
